note: City of Glasgow campground at the sharpest bend of the Missouri River: twelve back-in pads on the low river flat with the bank 20 to 40 m off beyond a line of big trees, six full-hookup sites on the bluff above with a view over the river, and a tent area. Bathhouse closed October 15 to April 15, when the water may also be shut off. The river flat floods. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: $35 a night ($36.23 with taxes and fees) for all 18 RV sites, all 50 A with water (stored 30 A corrected), sewer at the six upper sites, dump, bathhouse; reservation only; holiday 2-night minimum. Riverfront stands on a count of the lower pads. Pin on the lower pads. Phone matches (City Hall). Winter status is the open question.
flags: ELECTRIC: stored 30 A (note said 20/30A) -> 50 A. The rules page gives 50 amp service at all 18 sites, lower and upper.

WATERFRONT (stored riverfront, evidence was a commit reference only; no change): counted on the 0.56 m/px leaf-off frame. The lower level is a row of about twelve parallel gravel back-in pads on the west side of the gravel lane (Hazel Ln) on the river flat; their river ends are 20-40 m from the Missouri's bank, across mown ground with one line of large bank trees and no understory, so the water is in plain sight from the pads. 12 of the 18 RV sites (all the lower level, which the operator calls 'Riverfront lot next to the river') are within 50 m on open ground. The six upper sites are on the bluff about 150 m back ('River View lot'). Riverfront supported.

SEASON / WINTER (not written; question for the owner): the rules say the bathhouse is closed October 15 - April 15 and, under 'CLOSED', 'From October 15 - April 15, winter months, camping can be allowed with Park Board approval. During freezing temperatures or as needed, the Park may shut off the water'. But the booking engine sells every RV site this week (2026-11-10: 19 accommodations; 2026-11-13: 17) and on 2027-01-12 (19) at the normal $36.23, with no approval step shown. So it is bookable in winter without a bathhouse and possibly without water. I left season unwritten rather than mark it closed Oct 15 - Apr 15 against a live calendar; the note carries the winter limits.

BOOKING WINDOW: the engine returns 'No accommodations found' for 2027-04-20, 2027-05-11 and 2027-06-15 while selling 2027-01-12, so the calendar is not yet open for next season. Window length not stated anywhere; not written.
FEES: the '+ fees' is 3.5% ($1.23 on $35); the engine's own wording is 'includes taxes and fees', no breakdown shown, so no tax percent is written. Weekend price is the same as weeknight.

LONG STAY: a monthly rate is offered ($425, prorated after the first month). All 18 sites are in the nightly online inventory and nearly all were open on the dates searched, so no sign that monthly tenants hold the sites; city park, not a residential park.

FLOODING: nothing on the site reports a current closure; the refund rule names flooding. The lower level is on the river flat beside the bank; 'floods' kept in the note.
